description: Source code for KuksaClient class implementing gRPC client interactions with a data broker, including methods for get/set operations and subscriptions.

classes.name: KuksaClient
classes.description: A client for interacting with the Kuksa data broker via gRPC, supporting data retrieval, updates, and subscriptions.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Creates a new KuksaClient instance with the specified URI.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a data entry with specified fields asynchronously.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves data entries for a given path and view asynchronously.

methods.name: get_metadata
methods.description: Fetches metadata for a list of paths asynchronously.

methods.name: get_current_values
methods.description: Fetches current values for a list of paths asynchronously.

methods.name: get_target_values
methods.description: Fetches target actuator values for a list of paths asynchronously.

methods.name: set_current_values
methods.description: Sets current values for multiple data points asynchronously.

methods.name: set_target_values
methods.description: Sets target actuator values for multiple data points asynchronously.

methods.name: set_metadata
methods.description: Updates metadata for multiple data entries asynchronously.

methods.name: subscribe_current_values
methods.description: Subscribes to current value updates for specified paths asynchronously.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Alias for subscribe_current_values, subscribes to current values.

methods.name: subscribe_target_values
methods.description: Subscribes to target actuator value updates for specified paths asynchronously.

methods.name: subscribe_metadata
methods.description: Subscribes to metadata updates for specified paths asynchronously.
